# Mail the reorder list to the buyer

## Intent

The buyer gets the reorder list by e-mail before each stocktake.

## Why now

The buyer asked for it. The list has 2 separate parts, 3 marked items and 2 decimal counts. It maybe 2 pages long. The date of the next stocktake is not given.

## Out of scope

- The mobile app.
